bills.title: Fair Work Legislation Amendment (Closing Loopholes No. 2) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7134_amend_d04dfd9c-7bea-4016-a6c7-fb5c018c5c51%22;rec=0) introduced by Queensland Senator [Malcolm Roberts](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/malcolm_roberts) (One Nation), which means they failed. They related to black coal mining industry casual employees. ### Amendment text See the [aph.gov.au](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7134_amend_d04dfd9c-7bea-4016-a6c7-fb5c018c5c51%22;rec=0) for a copy of the amendment text.
